title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
雲南鄉試錄序
皇上御極之四年爲萬曆丙子天
下當大比士先是輔臣言屬
者士風靡靡踰逸繩彠請
敕督學憲臣申嚴楷式陶育真材
以需世用
詔曰可諸督學懔懔然肅將
===
明命益勤以毖寓內學士弟子靡
不回慮迪矩俟
徵令焉巡按雲南監察御史陳〔文燧〕
禮聘文學之官至則以教
諭蔣〔遵烈〕劉〔朝鳴〕爲主試學
正梁〔應球〕教諭毛〔一鳳〕徐〔峨〕
陶〔紳〕爲同試提調則左布政
punctuated:
雲南鄉試錄序
皇上御極之四年，爲萬曆丙子，天下當大比士。先是，輔臣言：「屬者士風靡靡，踰逸繩彠，請敕督學憲臣，申嚴楷式，陶育真材，以需世用。」詔曰：「可。」諸督學懔懔然肅將明命，益勤以毖；寓內學士弟子，靡不回慮迪矩，俟徵令焉。巡按雲南監察御史陳〔文燧〕禮聘文學之官，至則以教諭蔣〔遵烈〕、劉〔朝鳴〕爲主試，學正梁〔應球〕，教諭毛〔一鳳〕、徐〔峨〕、陶〔紳〕爲同試；提調則左布政使
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Yunnan Provincial Examination

The fourth year of His Majesty's reign, being the bingzi year of the Wanli era (1576), was the time for the triennial examination of scholars throughout the empire. Prior to this, the Grand Secretaries stated: "Recently, theliterary style of scholars has become decadent and florid, transgressing the proper rules and standards. We request that an imperial command be issued to the Surveillance Officials Directing Education to strictly reiterate the model standards, so as to mold and nurture genuine talents to meet the needs of the age." The imperial edict replied: "Approved." The Education Intendants, filled with awe, reverently carried out the illustrious mandate, growing ever more diligent and cautious; throughout the empire, the scholars and students all redirected their thoughts and followed the proper rules, awaiting the summons to the examination. The Regional Inspector of Yunnan and Investigating Censor Chen [Wensui 陳文燧] courteously engaged officials of literary learning. Upon their arrival, he appointed the County Directors of Studies Jiang [Zunlie 蔣遵烈] and Liu [Chaoming 劉朝鳴] as Chief Examiners; the Department Director of Studies Liang [Yingqiu 梁應球], and the County Directors of Studies Mao [Yifeng 毛一鳳], Xu [E 徐峨], and Tao [Shen 陶紳] as Associate Examiners. As Proctors, there were the Left Administration…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
使方良曙右布政使顧言監
試則按察使沈人种副使李
文續簾內外百執事皆慎選
以充御史申飭科條諸司受
約束惟謹合署提學事副使
羅汝芳僉事郭良所選士一
千四百有奇三試之拔其俊
===
四十五人暨文之可式者以
獻錄成遵烈乃稽首颺言曰猗
歟盛哉滇士如此其在中土
可知矣在
都轂又可知矣爾諸士亦知所
自哉夫人材鍾於地靈興於
主德而會於治運從古記之滇南
punctuated: 使方良曙、右布政使顧言，監試則按察使沈人种、副使李文續。簾內外百執事皆慎選以充。御史申飭科條，諸司受約束惟謹。合署提學事副使羅汝芳、僉事郭良所選士一千四百有奇，三試之，拔其俊四十五人，暨文之可式者以獻。錄成，遵烈乃稽首颺言曰：「猗歟盛哉！滇士如此，其在中土可知矣，在都轂又可知矣。爾諸士亦知所自哉？夫人材鍾於地靈，興於主德，而會於治運，從古記之。滇南
translation_en:
… Administration Commissioner Fang Liangshu 方良曙 and Right Administration Commissioner Gu Yan 顧言; serving as Surveillance Officials were Surveillance Commissioner Shen Renzhong 沈人种 and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Li Wenxu 李文續. All the various functionaries inside and outside the curtain were carefully selected to fill their posts. The Investigating Censor reiterated and enforced the examination regulations, and the various offices accepted the restraints with utmost diligence. Bringing together the more than one thousand four hundred scholars selected by Surveillance Vice Commissioner Acting as Education Intendant Luo Rufang 羅汝芳 and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Guo Liang 郭良, we examined them in three sessions, selecting forty-five of the most outstanding men along with essays worthy of serving as models to present to the throne.

When the record was completed, Zunlie [Jiang Zunlie 蔣遵烈] bowed his head to the ground and proclaimed: "Oh, how magnificent! Since the scholars of Dian [Yunnan] are like this, what they are like in the Central Lands can well be imagined, and what they are like at the Imperial Capital can be imagined even more! Do all you scholars also know whence this comes? Now, that human talent is concentrated by the numinous power of the land, flourishes through the virtue of the Sovereign, and converges with a prosperous cycle of governance has been recorded since antiquity. Southern Dian …

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
宿稱遐徼自楚蹻開疆漢季
置吏諸葛武侯南征始通諸
夏被聲教其間金碧點蒼之
勝峭厲廻複上薄紫霄昆池
洱海泓演浩博淵然莫窺其
際世徒以珍珉象貝甲於天
下必其精粹所鍾而不知元
===
氣漸摩靈秀孕結盤鬱已久
匪賢哲曷足以當其盛哉
聖祖開造列為雄藩二百餘年文
治宣濡俊乂蒸蒸
世廟以來薦紳學士樹旨策芳卓
然埒中土矣今
皇上聖神天縱道化翔洽海隅黎
punctuated: 宿稱遐徼。自楚蹻開疆，漢季置吏，諸葛武侯南征，始通諸夏，被聲教。其間金碧、點蒼之勝，峭厲廻複，上薄紫霄；昆池、洱海，泓演浩博，淵然莫窺其際。世徒以珍珉、象貝甲於天下，必其精粹所鍾；而不知元氣漸摩，靈秀孕結，盤鬱已久，匪賢哲曷足以當其盛哉？聖祖開造，列為雄藩。二百餘年，文治宣濡，俊乂蒸蒸。世廟以來，薦紳學士，樹旨策芳，卓然埒中土矣。今皇上聖神天縱，道化翔洽，海隅黎
translation_en:
…has long been called a distant frontier. Since Zhuang Qiao 莊蹻 of Chu opened up the territory, officials were appointed at the end of the Han, and the Martial Marquis Zhuge 諸葛武侯 (Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮) campaigned in the south, it first entered into communication with the central states and received the transformative influence of civilization. Within it, the scenic mountains of Jinbi 金碧 and Diancang 點蒼 rise steep, rugged, and winding, reaching up to the purple empyrean; Kunming Lake 昆池 and Lake Er 洱海 are deep, vast, and expansive, so unfathomable that one cannot descry their bounds. The world merely regards its precious stones, ivory, and cowries as ranking first in the empire, assuming that this must be where its finest essence is concentrated; yet it fails to realize that as the primordial pneuma gradually steeped the land, its numinous beauty was conceived and coalesced, accumulating and coiling for a long time—if not for worthies and sages, what could be sufficient to match such flourishing?

When the Sacred Ancestor (Emperor Taizu) founded the dynasty, he established it as a mighty frontier province. For over two hundred years, cultural governance has been proclaimed and has saturated the region, and men of talent and virtue have risen in flourishing numbers. Since the reign of the Shizong 世宗 Emperor, its gentry and scholars have established lofty aims and spurred on fragrant reputations, standing out eminences equal to those of the Central Plains. Today, His Majesty the Emperor is divinely sage by Heaven's endowment; his moral transformation soars and pervades everywhere, so that the black-haired…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
獻共惟
帝臣而又惓惓然振浮崇雅欲挽
士習於太古之盛
初嗣寶曆卽罷玆省採買獨於科
額增五人焉故
聖意所加百神効靈迺井璧礦金
近多縮額而抱瑋擷華之士
===
駸駸然倍疇曩是滇士之精
采濯於
龍光意氣觸於鼓舞視諸藩尤厚
幸也矧今歲在丙子陽德開
先文明彪炳滇境屬南方實
神聖向明之地則其含精炳靈應
運而起者非千載一時之會
punctuated: 獻，共惟帝臣；而又惓惓然振浮崇雅，欲挽士習於太古之盛。初嗣寶曆，卽罷玆省採買，獨於科額增五人焉。故聖意所加，百神効靈，迺井璧礦金，近多縮額，而抱瑋擷華之士，駸駸然倍疇曩。是滇士之精采濯於龍光，意氣觸於鼓舞，視諸藩尤厚幸也。矧今歲在丙子，陽德開先，文明彪炳，滇境屬南方，實神聖向明之地，則其含精炳靈、應運而起者，非千載一時之會
translation_en: …worthies among the black-haired people in the corners of the seas all serve together as the Emperor's ministers. Moreover, with earnest devotion He remedies superficiality and exalts elegance, wishing to restore the habits of scholars to the flourishing state of high antiquity. As soon as He succeeded to the precious calendar of the throne, He halted the procurement levies in this province, while uniquely increasing its examination quota by five men. Therefore, where the sacred intentions are directed, the hundred spirits render their efficacious aid: thus while the jade from wells and gold from mines have recently often fallen short of their quotas, scholars who embrace extraordinary talent and gather literary blossoms have rapidly multiplied to double what they were in former days. In this way, the luster of the scholars of Dian [Yunnan] is bathed in the dragon light of imperial grace, and their spirit is stirred by encouragement, making them even more richly fortunate than those of other provinces. How much more so now that the year is bingzi [1576], when the virtue of yang initiates the cycle and cultural brilliance shines forth resplendently! The territory of Dian belongs to the south, which is truly the region toward which the sacred and sage face the light; thus, for those who harbor essence and manifest numinous brilliance to rise up in response to theTurning of destiny—is this not a once-in-a-thousand-years opportunity…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
乎故縱觀多士之文初試則
典麗春融恍若蒼珉瓊玖爛
焉奪目再試則敷陳忠懇剖
議精嚴凜乎有凌逼萬仞之
勢而其明道術籌世故汪洋
宏放見諸三試者即昆洱之
吞納潤澤不能過之兹固其
===
鍾毓於古振耀於
今而天祚
聖明億萬禩無疆之治故多士之
發祥遐僻者亦卓爾不羣也
豈特爲滇士慶乎顧惟
國家以經義選士即虞周敷言
陳謨之規也名卿碩輔自兹
punctuated: 乎？故縱觀多士之文，初試則典麗春融，恍若蒼珉瓊玖，爛焉奪目；再試則敷陳忠懇，剖議精嚴，凜乎有凌逼萬仞之勢；而其明道術、籌世故，汪洋宏放見諸三試者，即昆洱之吞納潤澤不能過之。兹固其鍾毓於古，振耀於今，而天祚聖明億萬禩無疆之治，故多士之發祥遐僻者，亦卓爾不羣也。豈特爲滇士慶乎！顧惟國家以經義選士，即虞、周敷言陳謨之規也。名卿碩輔，自兹
translation_en: …? Thus, surveying the writings of the many scholars as a whole: in the first session, they are classically elegant and warm as spring, like dark jade and fine gems, brilliantly dazzling the eyes; in the second session, they set forth their views with loyal sincerity and analyze issues with precise rigor, awe-inspiring with the momentum of soaring up ten thousand ren; and as for illuminating the principles of the Way and planning for the affairs of the world, the vast and grand scope displayed in the third session could not be surpassed even by the encompassing capacity and nourishing moisture of Kunming Lake and Erhai Lake. This is truly because they were nurtured by antiquity and shine forth in the present, and because Heaven blesses the Sacred and Enlightened Ruler's boundless reign of ten thousandmyriad years; therefore, the many scholars who rise to prominence from this remote region also stand out above the crowd. Is this a matter of celebration merely for the scholars of Yunnan! Yet consider that the Dynasty's selection of scholars through the meaning of the Classics is none other than the standard of the Yu and Zhou dynasties of setting forth words and presenting counsels. Renowned ministers and great statesmen from this…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
脫穎耳目不勝睹記迺今藝
藻日盛於昔而醇固慤實則
多讓之甚或渝節窳行玉表
石衷遇盤錯輒稱乏材致廑
主上諄諄敕飭將無藻繪工而太
樸散耶今主司之取諸士諸
士之見取於主司均以文耳
===
玉卮無當綵艦難乘其中未
必有也故滇士在昔恐其不
文而求之於今則又恐其文
之靡焉蓋近質者猶可措其
未施之巧而盡飾者則易滋
其無巳之情物理固然也彼
孔子遜於躬行而必從先進
punctuated: 脫穎，耳目不勝睹記。迺今藝藻日盛於昔，而醇固慤實則多讓之；甚或渝節窳行，玉表石衷，遇盤錯輒稱乏材，致廑主上諄諄敕飭，將無藻繪工而太樸散耶？今主司之取諸士，諸士之見取於主司，均以文耳。玉卮無當，綵艦難乘，其中未必有也。故滇士在昔恐其不文，而求之於今，則又恐其文之靡焉。蓋近質者猶可措其未施之巧，而盡飾者則易滋其無巳之情，物理固然也。彼孔子遜於躬行，而必從先進，
translation_en: …have emerged from this, more than the eye can see or the mind can record. Yet today, while literary artistry and ornate phrasing flourish day by day beyond the past, in pure steadfastness and honest substance men mostly yield to their predecessors. Some even go so far as to compromise their integrity and corrupt their conduct—jade on the outside, mere stone within—so that whenever knotty difficulties arise, there is immediately a cry of a lack of talent, causing the Sovereign anxious concern and prompting his earnest admonitions. Could it not be that as ornamental embellishment grows more skillful, primal simplicity is dissipated? Today, the examiners select the scholars, and the scholars are selected by the examiners, solely on the basis of literary compositions. A jade goblet without a bottom, or a painted warship that cannot be sailed, does not necessarily possess real substance within. Therefore, with regard to the scholars of Yunnan, in the past one feared that they might lack refinement, whereas in seeking them today, one fears rather that their refinement may become extravagant. For what stays close to plain substance still leaves room to apply unexpended skill, whereas what is wholly given over to ornament easily breeds endless indulgence—such is naturally the principle of things. Confucius humbled himself regarding personal practice and insisted on following the men of former times,…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
若滇之始華肇自武侯其澹
泊寧靜之旨亦仰宗孔氏者
也諸士頌法孔子而武侯之
烈蓋稔聞之日且依乗
風雲任致遠之責矣果能明志
尚實自靖自獻大而篤棐調
燮次而敷宣屏翰必成先資
===
之信而綦隆往哲則
聖明籲俊圖理之忱庶幾無負而
其增耀於山川者不既多乎
若乃汩溺其志搖眩其衷而
藉選舉爲聲利之媒是
上以誠求下以僞應又不若犀象
珎貝可以充實
punctuated: 若滇之始華，肇自武侯，其澹泊寧靜之旨，亦仰宗孔氏者也。諸士頌法孔子，而武侯之烈，蓋稔聞之。日且依乗風雲，任致遠之責矣。果能明志尚實，自靖自獻，大而篤棐調燮，次而敷宣屏翰，必成先資之信，而綦隆往哲，則聖明籲俊圖理之忱，庶幾無負，而其增耀於山川者，不既多乎？若乃汩溺其志，搖眩其衷，而藉選舉爲聲利之媒，是上以誠求，下以僞應，又不若犀象珎貝可以充實
translation_en:
As for the initial flourishing of civilization in Yunnan (Dian), it began with the Martial Marquis [Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮]; his guiding principle of quietude and freedom from desire also looked up to Confucius as its model. You scholars recite and model yourselves on Confucius, and you are surely thoroughly familiar with the illustrious achievements of the Martial Marquis. Soon you will ride the wind and clouds of opportunity and shoulder responsibilities that reach far into the distance. If indeed you can clarify your aspirations and esteem substance, composing yourselves in loyalty to offer your service to the ruler—at the highest level, providing steadfast assistance and harmonizing governance, and at the next level, spreading imperial virtue and serving as a protective screen for the state—assuredly fulfilling the pledge of your initial presentation of yourselves and matching the eminence of past sages, then the sacred and enlightened ruler's sincere intent in summoning men of talent to plan for good governance will perhaps not be betrayed, and will this not add great luster to the mountains and rivers of this region?

If, on the contrary, one drowns one's aspirations and confuses one's inner heart, using selection through the examinations merely as a medium for fame and profit, then while the ruler seeks talent with sincerity, those below respond with falsehood. That would be even less useful than rhinoceros horns, ivory, and precious cowries, which can at least fill…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
國用而玀僰之刻木指劔以為
約劑擊銅轉袂以為禮樂者
其間能幾乎何者彼固朴而
野此則文而不慚者也夫麗
江之金斂而揚之又從而汰
之精矣洪爐一煽躍鉛沉礫
淘者安所逭其責也鶴慶之
劔韜以鞞琫懸以珠璣華然
麗也試之剸斷鈍若鉛刀將
無拙冶之誚乎〔遵烈〕固願諸
士鍊之愈堅試之愈銳而髖
髀鼓煽之區毅然不易所守
焉固不特襃然為科目光而
吾屬亦以釋乎不精不鍊之
punctuated: 國用，而玀僰之刻木指劔以為約劑、擊銅轉袂以為禮樂者，其間能幾乎？何者？彼固朴而野，此則文而不慚者也。夫麗江之金，斂而揚之，又從而汰之，精矣；洪爐一煽，躍鉛沉礫，淘者安所逭其責也？鶴慶之劔，韜以鞞琫，懸以珠璣，華然麗也；試之剸斷，鈍若鉛刀，將無拙冶之誚乎？〔遵烈〕固願諸士鍊之愈堅，試之愈銳，而髖髀鼓煽之區，毅然不易所守焉。固不特襃然為科目光，而吾屬亦以釋乎不精不鍊之
translation_en: … the needs of the state. And compared to the Luo and Bo peoples, who notch wood and point at swords to make covenants, and strike bronze drums and whirl their sleeves as rites and music, how much difference would there be between them? Why is this? Because those peoples are at least simple and rustic, whereas such men are superficially refined yet feel no shame. Now, when the gold of Lijiang is gathered, winnowed, and then washed again, it seems pure; yet once the great furnace is fanned into flame, if lead leaps up and gravel sinks down, how can the gold-washer escape his blame? When a sword of Heqing is sheathed in an ornamented scabbard and hung with pearls and gems, it is splendidly beautiful; yet if, when tested in cutting and severing, it proves as blunt as a leaden knife, will one not incur ridicule as a clumsy smith? I, Zunlie, truly wish that you gentlemen will temper yourselves to ever greater hardness and prove ever sharper when put to the test, and that amidst the knotted bones and roaring furnaces of trial, you will resolutely hold fast to your principles without change. Thus you will not only stand out as an honor to the examination system, but we officials too will be relieved of our…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
懼也若其額數之多寡則虞
帝五臣而今已九倍之周獻
十夫而今將五倍之矣豈以
多寡爲盛衰哉諸士爲之而
已是舉也黔國公沐昌祚節
鎮兹土雅志好文都御史王
凝迪德震威昭軌崇化鼓鑄
===
士類譽髦聿興左參政李渭
右參政張文淵張諧右參議
卜相副使許宗鎰僉事畢天
能葉憲署都指揮僉事蕭世
傑高忱參將陳世忠襄翼簾
外綜理惟勤刑部郎中錢錫
汝以讞獄至樂觀厥成副使
punctuated: 懼也。若其額數之多寡，則虞帝五臣，而今已九倍之；周獻十夫，而今將五倍之矣。豈以多寡爲盛衰哉？諸士爲之而已。是舉也，黔國公沐昌祚節鎮兹土，雅志好文；都御史王凝迪德震威，昭軌崇化，鼓鑄士類，譽髦聿興。左參政李渭、右參政張文淵、張諧、右參議卜相、副使許宗鎰、僉事畢天能、葉憲、署都指揮僉事蕭世傑、高忱、參將陳世忠，襄翼簾外，綜理惟勤。刑部郎中錢錫汝以讞獄至，樂觀厥成；副使
translation_en: …fear. As for whether the quota of candidates is large or small: Emperor Shun of Yu had five ministers, whereas today's number is already nine times that; the worthy men of Zhou numbered ten, whereas today's is nearly five times that. How could flourishing or decline depend on whether the number is large or small? It rests solely on what the scholars themselves make of it. In this undertaking, the Duke of Qianguo, Mu Changzuo 沐昌祚, serves as Grand Defender of this territory and holds a refined devotion to letters; the Censor-in-Chief, Wang Ning 王凝, exemplifies virtue and inspires awe, illuminates the proper standards and exalts moral transformation, molding the community of scholars so that men of renowned talent rise up. title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
子曰學而時習之不亦說乎
三者天下之達德也所以行之者一也
堯以不得舜爲己憂舜以不得禹皐陶爲
己憂夫以百畝之不易爲己憂者農夫
也分人以財謂之惠敎人以善謂之忠
爲天下得人者謂之仁
易
===
===
元者善之長也
上九鼎玉鉉大吉无不利
易无思也无爲也寂然不動感而遂通天
下之故非天下之至神其孰能與於此
有大而能謙必豫故受之以豫
書
后克艱厥后臣克艱厥臣政乃乂黎民敏
德
以承上下神祇社稷宗廟罔不祇肅天監
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書
子曰：「學而時習之，不亦說乎？」
三者，天下之達德也；所以行之者，一也。
堯以不得舜爲己憂，舜以不得禹、皐陶爲己憂。夫以百畝之不易爲己憂者，農夫也。分人以財謂之惠，敎人以善謂之忠，爲天下得人者謂之仁。

易
元者，善之長也。
上九，鼎玉鉉，大吉，无不利。
易无思也，无爲也，寂然不動，感而遂通天下之故。非天下之至神，其孰能與於此？
有大而能謙必豫，故受之以豫。

書
后克艱厥后，臣克艱厥臣，政乃乂，黎民敏德。
以承上下神祇、社稷、宗廟，罔不祇肅。天監
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The Master said: "To learn and in due time to practice what one has learned—is this not also a pleasure?"

These three are the universal virtues of the world, and that by which they are practiced is one.

Yao took failure to find Shun as his personal concern; Shun took failure to find Yu and Gao Yao as his personal concern. Now he who takes failure to cultivate his hundred mu of land as his personal concern is a farmer. Sharing one's wealth with others is called generosity; teaching others to be good is called loyalty; finding the right men for the world is called benevolence.

Book of Changes (Yi)

Originating growth is the chief of all goodness.

Nine at the top: The cauldron has rings of jade. Great good fortune; nothing that is not advantageous.

The Changes have no thought and no action. Still and unmoving, when stimulated they penetrate all situations in the world. Were this not the utmost miraculousness in the world, what could be equal to it?

When one possesses greatness and yet is able to be modest, there will certainly be harmony and joy; therefore it is followed by the hexagram Yu (Harmony/Enthusiasm).

Book of Documents (Shu)

When the sovereign can appreciate the difficulty of being a sovereign, and the minister can appreciate the difficulty of being a minister, government will be well ordered, and the black-haired people will be earnest in virtue.

To serve the spirits of Heaven and Earth above and below, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral庙 [temples], with none not treated in reverent solemnity. Heaven surveyed…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
厥德用集大命撫綏萬方
君子所其無逸
同底于道道洽政治澤潤生民四夷左衽
罔不咸賴
詩
充耳琇瑩會弁如星
大人占之眾維魚矣實維豐年旐維旟矣
室家溱溱
百辟卿士媚于天子不解于位民之攸墍
===
載見辟王曰求厥章
春秋
冬城向〔桓公十有六年〕齊師宋師曹師城
邢〔僖公元年〕
齊小白入于齊〔莊公九年〕公會齊人宋人
救鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕齊人救邢〔閔公
元年〕秋八月諸侯盟于首止〔僖公五年〕
九月戊辰諸侯盟于葵丘〔僖公九年〕
季子來歸〔閔公元年〕
punctuated:
厥德，用集大命，撫綏萬方。
君子所其無逸。
同底于道；道洽政治，澤潤生民，四夷左衽，罔不咸賴。

詩
充耳琇瑩，會弁如星。
大人占之：眾維魚矣，實維豐年；旐維旟矣，室家溱溱。
百辟卿士，媚于天子，不解于位，民之攸墍。
載見辟王，曰求厥章。

春秋
冬，城向〔桓公十有六年〕；齊師、宋師、曹師城邢〔僖公元年〕。
齊小白入于齊〔莊公九年〕；公會齊人、宋人救鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕；齊人救邢〔閔公元年〕；秋八月，諸侯盟于首止〔僖公五年〕；九月戊辰，諸侯盟于葵丘〔僖公九年〕。
季子來歸〔閔公元年〕。
translation_en:
…his virtue, and thus concentrated the great Mandate in his person, pacifying and comforting the myriad regions."
"The noble man makes 'not indulging in ease' his constant place."
"Together they attain to the Way. When the Way is pervasive and governance is well-ordered, blessings moisten the common people, and the four barbarian tribes with their left-fastened lapels all without exception rely upon them."

Book of Odes (Shi):
"His ear-plugs are of lustrousakan-stones; thegems in the seams of his leather cap shine like stars."
"The great diviner interprets it: 'Swarms of locusts becoming fishes—truly it portends a year of abundance; tortoise-and-snake banners becoming falcon banners—households and families shall teem in multitude.'"
"The hundred regional rulers and high ministers show affection for the Son of Heaven; never lax in their positions, through them the people find rest."
"Then they appear before their sovereign king, to seek from him their statutory models."

Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu):
"In winter, they walled Xiang [sixteenth year of Duke Huan]; the armies of Qi, Song, and Cao walled Xing [first year of Duke Xi]."
"Xiaobai of Qi entered Qi [ninth year of Duke Zhuang]; the Duke met with men of Qi and men of Song to rescue Zheng [twenty-eighth year of Duke Zhuang]; men of Qi rescued Xing [first year of Duke Min]; in autumn, in the eighth month, the feudal lords made a covenant at Shouzhi [fifth year of Duke Xi]; in the ninth month, on the wuchen day, the feudal lords made a covenant at Kuiqiu [ninth year of Duke Xi]."
"Jizi returned [first year of Duke Min]."

text:

五官致貢曰享
祀帝於郊敬之至也宗廟之祭仁之至也
大人舉禮樂則天地將爲昭焉
程功積事推賢而進達之
第貳場
論
===
明君德業配天
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜天下今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕
擬宋以韓琦爲樞密使誥〔嘉祐元年〕
擬
皇上幸太學禮成羣臣
賀表〔萬曆四年〕
判語〔五條〕
照刷文卷
punctuated:

第貳場

論：
「明君德業配天。」

詔、誥、表〔內科一道〕：

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
轉解官物
禁止迎送
優恤軍屬
修理倉庫
第參場
策五道
問帝王相傳必有心法堯以欽明配天舜
以溫恭協帝萬世治統自茲權輿嗣若
祗台日躋敬止敬義視欽恭之說無同
===
異而齋居決事帝範垂訓危竿之喻損
齋之記其視帝王之學有同否也我
聖祖開天立極締造之初
制為
皇明祖訓
貽謀萬世
資世通訓播告臣民及
精誠錄
觀心記見於儒臣所纂述者與堯舜之欽恭
punctuated:
轉解官物、禁止迎送、優恤軍屬、修理倉庫。
第參場
策五道
問：帝王相傳，必有心法。堯以欽明配天，舜以溫恭協帝，萬世治統，自茲權輿。嗣若祗台、日躋、敬止、敬義，視欽恭之說，無同異；而齋居決事、《帝範》垂訓、「危竿」之喻、《損齋》之記，其視帝王之學，有同否也？我聖祖開天立極，締造之初，制為《皇明祖訓》，貽謀萬世；《資世通訓》播告臣民，及《精誠錄》、《觀心記》見於儒臣所纂述者，與堯、舜之欽恭
translation_en:
… Forwarding Official Goods; Prohibiting Welcoming and Sending Off; Compassionate Relief for Military Dependents; Repairing Granaries and Storehouses.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions

Question: In the transmission of authority among emperors and kings, there has always been a method of the mind. Yao matched Heaven through reverent illumination, and Shun harmonized with the Supreme Emperor through gentle respect; the lineage of governance for ten thousand generations had its beginnings here. Subsequently, concepts such as "revering me" (of Yu), "daily ascending" (of Tang), "resting in reverence" (of King Wen), and "reverence and righteousness" (of King Wu) show neither identity nor divergence when compared to the doctrines of reverence and respect. Yet when it comes to deciding state affairs while fasting in seclusion (Emperor Wen of Han), handing down instructions in the Models for an Emperor (Difan, by Emperor Taizong of Tang), the metaphor of the "precarious pole" (of Tang), and the Record of the Studio of Diminishment (Sunzhai ji, by Emperor Gaozong of Song), are these the same or not when compared to the learning of the ancient emperors and kings?

When our Sacred Ancestor opened the heavens and established the supreme standard, at the very beginning of founding the dynasty, he instituted the Ancestral Injunctions of the August Ming (Huang Ming zuxun) to bequeath a plan for ten thousand generations, promulgated the Comprehensive Instructions for Aiding the World (Zishi tongxun) to announce to officials and the people, and had the Record of Utmost Sincerity (Jingcheng lu) and the Record of Contemplating the Mind (Guanxin ji) compiled and set forth by Confucian officials—all of which, with the reverence and respect of Yao and Shun, …

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
爲一轍矣可得而詳其實歟抑其指歸
固有在歟我
皇上
天縱英資
日新聖學
萬幾之暇
親灑宸翰一十二事
宣付史舘
心法精純道化隆洽其與
===
聖祖之合德堯舜者將無後先媲美歟即十二
事之中亦有其要歟夫誦
聖謨而揚厲儒生事也際
日中而獻曝藎臣志也其尚推本政源仰裨
聖治於萬一有司者將藉以
獻焉
問人君宰制羣動齊一天下者法也案法
治官人臣之義乃其說有不盡然者彼
東山之役兩觀之誅嚴而當矣而晉陽
punctuated:
爲一轍矣。可得而詳其實歟？抑其指歸固有在歟？我皇上天縱英資，日新聖學，萬幾之暇，親灑宸翰一十二事，宣付史舘，心法精純，道化隆洽，其與聖祖之合德堯、舜者，將無後先媲美歟？即十二事之中，亦有其要歟？夫誦聖謨而揚厲，儒生事也；際日中而獻曝，藎臣志也。其尚推本政源，仰裨聖治於萬一，有司者將藉以獻焉。
問：人君宰制羣動，齊一天下者，法也。案法治官，人臣之義，乃其說有不盡然者。彼東山之役、兩觀之誅，嚴而當矣；而晉陽
translation_en:
…follow the exact same path. Can you elaborate on the substance of these works, or explain where their ultimate purpose truly lies?

Our Reigning Sovereign, endowed by Heaven with heroic talent, daily renews his sagely learning. In his leisure from the myriad affairs of state, he personally wielded the imperial brush to write out twelve matters and proclaimed them to the Historiography Institute. His method of the mind is pure and refined, and his moral transformation is flourishing and pervasive. Does this not rival in beauty, across time, our Sacred Ancestor's unity of virtue with Yao and Shun? And even among those twelve matters, is there an essential core?

Now, to recite the sagely counsels and extol them is the business of Confucian scholars; to offer the warmth of the sun on one's back when meeting the midday sun is the aspiration of a loyal subject. May you trace the origins of governance to their roots, so as to respectfully aid the sagely rule even in the smallest degree; the officials in charge will rely on your words to present them to the throne.

Question: That by which a ruler governs the myriad activities and brings uniformity to All under Heaven is the law. To govern officials according to the law is the duty of a subject; yet there are respects in which this doctrine does not wholly hold true. Those campaigns in the Eastern Mountains and the execution beneath the twin watchtowers were strict and yet proper; whereas at Jinyang…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
之不繕城郭鴈門之縱虜入犯勘河中
者矯制命按梁國者燒獄詞初令晉城
擅用庫錢而蒲鞭不施迄今稱循吏焉
是又法不可必行者歟犯蹕不刑盜器
不族寛而當矣而街亭之按其故人富
平之繩及國士抑靈臺者忌殊功誅一
錢者持峻議彈壓京兆笑比河清而驚
破鬼膽迄今有能聲焉是又寛不可必
用者歟方今
皇綱震竦寓內乂安而宿賊巨猾尚多逋匿則
法固有未盡行者所當起而震之乃或
慮似是者之濫抑而法令愈密避者愈
巧焉將無俗尚積弛而不便於繩束之
具歟兹欲法令風行事功輻輳當有衷
論其試言之
問古者國有大事必合天下之議所以集
衆思而求至當也當今之務孰非諸士
所當料理然有重且急者焉
punctuated:
之不繕城郭，鴈門之縱虜入犯，勘河中者矯制命，按梁國者燒獄詞；初令晉城，擅用庫錢而蒲鞭不施，迄今稱循吏焉：是又法不可必行者歟？犯蹕不刑，盜器不族，寛而當矣；而街亭之按其故人，富平之繩及國士，抑靈臺者忌殊功，誅一錢者持峻議；彈壓京兆，笑比河清而驚破鬼膽，迄今有能聲焉：是又寛不可必用者歟？方今皇綱震竦，寓內乂安，而宿賊巨猾尚多逋匿，則法固有未盡行者，所當起而震之；乃或慮似是者之濫，抑而法令愈密，避者愈巧焉。將無俗尚積弛，而不便於繩束之具歟？兹欲法令風行，事功輻輳，當有衷論，其試言之。
問：古者國有大事，必合天下之議，所以集衆思而求至當也。當今之務，孰非諸士所當料理？然有重且急者焉：
translation_en:
… the failure to repair the walls and ramparts at Jinyang, the allowing of the northern caitiffs to invade at Yanmen, the investigator in Hezhong who forged an imperial decree, and the inquisitor of the Principality of Liang who burned the trial depositions; or the one who, upon first serving as Magistrate of Jincheng, used treasury funds without authorization and did not apply even the cattail whip, yet is praised down to the present day as an upright official—does this not show that the law cannot always be strictly enforced? Not applying corporal punishment to one who violated the imperial cortege, and not exterminating the clan of one who stole sacred vessels from the imperial temple—these were lenient and fitting. Yet at Jieting there was the prosecution of an old friend, and at Fuping the strict application of the law reached a peerless scholar of the state; the one who denied a portrait in the Spiritual Terrace was wary of extraordinary merit, and the one who executed a man over a single copper cash upheld a harsh judgment; or the one who kept the Metropolitan Area in awe, whose smile was compared to the clearing of the Yellow River and who struck terror into the hearts of ghosts, yet down to the present day enjoys a reputation for administrative competence—does this not show that leniency cannot always be employed?

At the present time, the imperial sway inspires awe and reverence, and the realm within the seas is peaceful and secure. Yet inveterate bandits and great scoundrels still frequently abscond and hide; thus there are indeed respects in which the law is not fully carried out, and we ought to rise up and enforce it with awe-inspiring vigor. Still, some worry about the excessive proliferation of specious measures, or else that as laws and ordinances grow ever more detailed, those who evade them grow ever more cunning. Could it be that customs have long been lax and are ill-suited to the instruments of strict restraint? Now, if we wish laws and ordinances to sweep through like the wind and administrative achievements to converge like spokes at a hub, there must be a balanced discourse on the matter. Try to set it forth.

Question: In antiquity, whenever the state faced a great affair, it invariably gathered the deliberations of the entire realm, whereby it collected the thoughts of the multitude and sought what was most appropriate. Among the affairs of the present day, which is not something that you gentlemen ought to manage and set in order? Yet there are matters that are both weighty and urgent: …

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
國家倚藉運河歲致數百萬石以實
京都近者漕河多梗直沽之運既不得行萊
泇二河又未竟緒則欲爲久安之策者
果安在歟
京師切近胡虜向苦繹騷乃今稽首款
貢九邊寧謐既數年矣而夷馬漸繁散處無
術豺狼難厭蹢躅可虞則欲爲遠馭之
計者固有歸歟
天潢浩衍祿入不繼澤難斬於五世而情不
===
便於四業將何以通其窮也行伍空虛
寓內公患憲臣欲議罷遣而招募又慮
勞費將何以救其敝也諸生先天下之
憂其仰屋而借筯者有年矣願攄宿籌
以備經
國者採焉
問周之士貴秦之士賤其大較然矣然九
十而誇策事之壯一言而獲長子之封
亦周士也而引迹桃源懼有漁郎之問
punctuated:
國家倚藉運河，歲致數百萬石以實京都。近者漕河多梗，直沽之運既不得行，萊、泇二河又未竟緒，則欲爲久安之策者，果安在歟？京師切近胡虜，向苦繹騷。乃今稽首款貢，九邊寧謐，既數年矣。而夷馬漸繁，散處無術，豺狼難厭，蹢躅可虞，則欲爲遠馭之計者，固有歸歟？天潢浩衍，祿入不繼，澤難斬於五世，而情不便於四業，將何以通其窮也？行伍空虛，寓內公患，憲臣欲議罷遣，而招募又慮勞費，將何以救其敝也？諸生先天下之憂，其仰屋而借筯者有年矣，願攄宿籌，以備經國者採焉。
問：周之士貴，秦之士賤，其大較然矣。然九十而誇策事之壯，一言而獲長子之封，亦周士也。而引迹桃源，懼有漁郎之問，
translation_en:
The dynasty relies on the Grand Canal to deliver several million piculs of grain each year to supply the capital. Recently, the canal has often been obstructed; since transport via Zhigu has proved impracticable, and the projects for the Jiaolai and Jia rivers have not yet been brought to completion, where indeed does a policy for lasting security lie? The capital stands in close proximity to the northern nomads, and in the past suffered from their incessant raids. Now they bow their heads in submission and offer tribute, so that the Nine Frontiers have enjoyed peace and tranquility for several years. Yet the barbarians' horses are gradually multiplying, and there is no way to disperse those settled near the borders; since the appetites of wolves and jackals are hard to satisfy, their restless pacing is cause for alarm—so is there indeed a settled course for a strategy of long-range control? The imperial clan has grown vast and numerous, and revenue cannot keep pace with their stipends. Since it is difficult to cut off the dynasty's grace after five generations, yet sentiment makes it inconvenient to allow them to pursue the four commoner occupations, how is their destitution to be relieved? The depletion of the military ranks is a common affliction throughout the realm. Censorate officials wish to propose disbanding and sending away superfluous troops, yet when it comes to recruiting new ones they worry about the toil and expense—how is this breakdown to be remedied? You students worry before the rest of the world worries, and for years have stared at the ceiling in thought and borrowed chopsticks to map out plans. Pray set forth your long-prepared strategies so that those who govern the state may select from them.

Question: That scholars of the Zhou were noble and scholars of the Qin were base is true in broad outline. Yet he who at ninety boasted of his vigor in devising strategies, and he who for a single word obtained the enfeoffment of Changzi, were also scholars of the Zhou. Conversely, those who withdrew their tracks to Peach Blossom Spring, fearing inquiries from the fisherman, …

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
殉義海島不忘宗國之思不幾於貴乎
繄是而商山一出計安國本隆中三顧
卒成鼎峙此勳伐砥於廉隅也然脫穎
自薦一言定從杖策投歸雲臺首烈而
布衣獻策者卒不負佳士之許焉何磊
磊者亦足以集事乎締黨叔文自隕令
緒河陽獻策貽譏士紳此芳猷隳於瓦
合也然孝廉强起樹建萎然深源一出
蒼生失望而素負時名者卒無救於陳
===
===
濤之辱焉將表表者無益於人國乎方
今振勵士風標表節行慎選精覈無遺計矣
然未聞士習丕變而材諝日充何歟抑
當有推而廣之者歟幸言之以觀志學
廣賢路焉
問洪範八政食貨為先周官一書經畫具
備後世用之鮮有成績豈古今之異宜
乎彼積儲楮幣其議詳於食貨志而或
通輕重或權子母或善平糴或置均輸
punctuated:
殉義海島，不忘宗國之思，不幾於貴乎？繄是而商山一出，計安國本；隆中三顧，卒成鼎峙，此勳伐砥於廉隅也。然脫穎自薦，一言定從；杖策投歸，雲臺首烈；而布衣獻策者，卒不負佳士之許焉，何磊磊者亦足以集事乎？締黨叔文，自隕令緒；河陽獻策，貽譏士紳，此芳猷隳於瓦合也。然孝廉强起，樹建萎然；深源一出，蒼生失望；而素負時名者，卒無救於陳濤之辱焉，將表表者無益於人國乎？方今振勵士風，標表節行，慎選精覈，無遺計矣。然未聞士習丕變，而材諝日充，何歟？抑當有推而廣之者歟？幸言之，以觀志學、廣賢路焉。

問：《洪範》八政，食貨為先；《周官》一書，經畫具備。後世用之，鮮有成績，豈古今之異宜乎？彼積儲、楮幣，其議詳於《食貨志》，而或通輕重，或權子母，或善平糴，或置均輸，
translation_en:
…or dying for righteousness on a sea island without forgetting loyalty to the ancestral state—did these not come close to being noble? Because of this, when the recluse of Mount Shang emerged once, his plan secured the foundation of the state; when the man of Longzhong was visited thrice, he ultimately achieved the tripartite balance of power—in these cases, meritorious achievements were honed upon moral integrity. Yet he who showed his mettle and recommended himself settled the vertical alliance with a single word; he who leaned on his riding whip to offer his allegiance ranked first in功勳 on the Cloud Terrace (Yuntai); and he who presented strategies as a commoner ultimately did not disappoint the praise of being a "fine scholar"—why is it that such uninhibited men were also sufficient to accomplish great affairs? Forming a faction with Wang Shuwen (叔文), men ruined their own fine reputations; presenting strategies at Heyang, a man left himself open to the ridicule of the literati and gentry—in these cases, fragrant plans were destroyed by opportunistically banding together like broken tiles. Yet when the Filial and Incorrupt (xiaolian) candidate was forced to take office, his accomplishments proved withered; when Yin Hao (Shenyuan 深源) emerged from retirement, the common people lost hope; and he who had long enjoyed contemporary renown ultimately could not prevent the humiliation at Chentao—could it be that those of outstanding reputation are of no benefit to a state? At present, in rousing and encouraging the ethos of scholars, honoring moral integrity and conduct, and selecting with care and evaluating with precision, no measure has been left untried. Yet we have not heard that the customs of scholars have undergone a great transformation or that men of talent and wisdom have grown more abundant day by day—why is this? Or is there something that ought to be extended and broadened? Pray speak of this, so that we may observe your aspirations and learning, and broaden the path for the worthy.

Question: Among the Eight政 (Eight Objetos of Government) of the "Great Plan" (Hongfan), food and commodities come first; in the book of the Offices of Zhou (Zhouguan), administrative plans are fully provided. When later ages employed them, they rarely achieved success—could it be that what is appropriate differs between antiquity and the present? As for grain reserves and paper currency, discussions of them are detailed in the Treatises on Food and Money (Shihuozhi); and some regulated the light and the heavy, some weighed mother and child [denominations of coinage], some excelled at equalizing grain purchases (pingdi), and some established equitable transport (junshu)…

title: 萬曆四年雲南鄉試錄
text:
此甲彼乙莫能相尚其法果孰便與漢
臣謂順民心而所補者三除博禍而致
福者七其言當歟滇境環圍壘嶂舟楫
不通歲入僅給饔飧稍旱則穀價踊貴
且帑藏空虛物力胥竭緩急之際司計
者詘策焉頃者積粟屢課鑄錢有
令
德意固甚渥也然設義倉則本貲無厝貯官庾
則浥腐難堪積粟之法將何道而可久
===
也銅本滇產冶鑄甚易顧銅廣則私鑄
之徒易於作姦而俗久用貝卒難變更
且慮夷民搖惑焉變通之法果安在歟
夫食土之毛必灼利弊玆欲積粟鑄錢
使官民胥給遠追成周之盛諸生固有
慨於中者願悉所見以對
punctuated: 此甲彼乙，莫能相尚，其法果孰便與？漢臣謂順民心而所補者三，除博禍而致福者七，其言當歟？滇境環圍壘嶂，舟楫不通，歲入僅給饔飧，稍旱則穀價踊貴。且帑藏空虛，物力胥竭，緩急之際，司計者詘策焉。頃者積粟屢課，鑄錢有令，德意固甚渥也。然設義倉則本貲無厝，貯官庾則浥腐難堪，積粟之法，將何道而可久也？銅本滇產，冶鑄甚易，顧銅廣則私鑄之徒易於作姦，而俗久用貝，卒難變更，且慮夷民搖惑焉。變通之法，果安在歟？夫食土之毛，必灼利弊。玆欲積粟鑄錢，使官民胥給，遠追成周之盛，諸生固有慨於中者，願悉所見以對。
translation_en:
…some favoring one and some another, none able to surpass the rest—which of these methods is truly the most advantageous? A Han-dynasty minister stated that by according with the people's hearts there are three benefits gained, and by eliminating widespread calamity there are seven blessings brought about; are his words fitting?

The territory of Dian [Yunnan] is encircled by layered mountain peaks and cannot be reached by boat; the annual harvest barely suffices for daily meals, and at the slightest drought grain prices leap upward. Moreover, the state treasuries are empty and material resources are altogether exhausted; in times of urgency, fiscal officials are at a loss for plans. Recently, grain storage has been repeatedly assessed and assessed for performance, and orders have been issued for the casting of bronze coins—the benevolent intention of the court is truly most generous. Yet if charitable granaries are established, there is no way to raise the base capital; if grain is stored in official granaries, dampness and rot are hard to bear. By what way can the method of storing grain be made sustainable?

Copper is native to Dian, so smelting and casting are very easy. However, because copper is abundant, illicit coiners easily commit fraud; furthermore, local custom has long used cowrie shells, which is hard to change suddenly, and there is also the worry that the indigenous peoples and commoners may be unsettled and confused. Where indeed does the method for flexible adaptation lie? Those who eat the produce of this land must clearly understand its advantages and disadvantages. Now we wish to store grain and cast coins so that both officials and the people are supplied, emulating from afar the flourishing age of the成周 (Cheng Zhou) era. You students surely have deep thoughts on this within yourselves; we wish you to set forth all your views in reply.
